{{Recipe}}

== Ingredients ==

=== Salad ===

* 1 bowl of [[Cookbook:Zucchini|zucchini]], washed and [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* 1 bowl of [[Cookbook:Lettuce|lettuce]], washed
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] of cherry [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], washed and sliced

=== Dressing ===

* 2 [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemons]], juiced
* 2 [[Cookbook:Blood Orange|blood oranges]], juiced
* 1 [[Cookbook:Orange|orange]], juiced

== Procedure ==

# Combine the lemon juice, blood orange juice, and orange juice to make the dressing.
# Combine everything in a large bowl, and [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|toss]] well.
